_comment:
Mesh -> skeleton + skin -> FBX. Three defaults here are load-bearing, all found by failing on a real asset:
  skeleton_template=articulationxl, NOT mixamo. mixamo demands a fixed 52-bone humanoid and aborts with "Expected 52 bones for cls='vroid', got 22" whenever the predictor cannot resolve limbs - which is any figure whose arms hang against its body. articulationxl has no fixed count and fits any asset, at the cost of generic bone_N names instead of Mixamo ones. Use mixamo only for a clean T-pose humanoid, and only if you want Mixamo clips to retarget.
  precision=fp16, NOT auto. auto picks bf16 on Ampere/Ada and spconv 2.3.8 has no bfloat16 kernels, so skinning dies with a bare 'WorkerError: torch.bfloat16'.
  UniRigLoadMesh lists only files that existed when the container STARTED - comfy-env's isolated worker snapshots the node schema - so: copy your mesh into input/3d/, restart the container, then run. A file added afterwards is rejected with 'value_not_in_list'.
